create_habitat_sim_config: create a habitat-sim simulator configuration with rgb, depth, and semantic sensors using make_cfg
create_sensor_spec: create a camera sensor specification with a given uuid, type, hfov, resolution, position, and pitch
add_move_actions: add six movement actions including forward, backward, left, right, up, and down to an action space
add_turn_actions: add turn left and turn right actions with a specified rotation amount to an action space
add_look_actions: add look up and look down actions with a specified pitch amount to an action space
